target.statement: SUPIR w/ Ours achieves LIQE 4.056 on RealIR (Cameras), compared to SUPIR's 2.983
target.table_ref: Table 1, row 'SUPIR w/ Ours', column 'RealIR (Cameras)', metric LIQE
target.dataset: RealIR (Cameras) - 152 real LQ images from 8 imaging devices

compute.basis: Requires running SUPIR (SDXL-based diffusion restoration) on 152 images, plus the Res-Captioner (LLaVA-1.5-13B with LoRA) to generate captions; both are large models needing GPU memory and many diffusion steps per image.

blockers: No code or model weights released for Res-Captioner
Requires GPU (24GB VRAM) for SUPIR and LLaVA-1.5-13B
Training data for Res-Captioner (5,500 pairs) not released
Dependencies on multiple large pretrained models (SUPIR, LLaVA-1.5-13B, SDXL) with complex integration
title: Beyond Pixels: Text Enhances Generalization in Real-World Image Restoration
